req.title: Posts include author username
req.statement: The system shall join post rows with users so index/detail responses include the author's username.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return posts with the author's username included. This involves verifying that the database join operation between posts and users is correctly implemented and that the API response includes the expected data. The test suite will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_index_includes_author_username
expected: Response includes post with author's username
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' in r.data
assert b'test' in r.data  # author's username

tests.name: test_index_no_posts
expected: Response does not include any posts
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' not in r.data

tests.name: test_index_boundary_single_post
preconditions: Database initialized with a single post
expected: Response includes exactly one post with author's username
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post WHERE id != 1')
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.data.count(b'test title') == 1
assert b'test' in r.data  # author's username
